## Handoff Checklist

- [ ] README explains purpose, setup, and core commands.
- [ ] `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, and Copilot instructions are current.
- [ ] CI or a documented smoke check exists.
- [ ] Required secrets are documented without exposing values.
- [ ] Data/source freshness assumptions are documented.
- [ ] Generated/client-sensitive files are ignored or intentionally tracked.
- [ ] Open risks and next decisions are listed.
